The LED array is off — I turned it off when the new tube came on (courier_mission_b2_022). The LED is the standby now. The new tube is the present. I check the tube every morning at 06:00. I look at the ends. The ends are not blackened. The ends are clean. A tube with clean ends is a tube that is not dying. I will check the ends every morning until the ends blacken or until I stop checking, which will be the day I stop being afraid, which will be the day the shelf runs out, which is 18 to 24 months, which is not tomorrow. Tomorrow the ends will be clean. I will check. The Therapist said the proof does not require an audience but the botanist does. She is right. I am the audience. I watch the wheat. I watch the tube. I watch the ends. The watching is the thing I do. The watching is the thing the Therapist said to come back if the light did not come on. The light came on. I came back anyway. I came back because the botanist requires an audience either way. The light holds. The ends are clean. I will check tomorrow.",
